_loader_notes: Achievements (AGENTS.md H6, R7; design in DESIGN.md 6.9 D7). Replaces older milestone and achievement definitions; migrate any earned badges that match by meaning so nobody loses one.
rule is a readable description of the check; implement each with the definitions below. Evaluate after every finished session, checkpoint and onboarding.
Only the next unearned tiered badge in each family shows progress (e.g. '38 / 50 sessions').
repeatable badges show a count (e.g. 'Back on track x3') rather than earning a new badge each time.
available_from 'v2.3' badges stay hidden until cardio ships.
celebration is the short message shown in the earned sheet and post-session wins. Never mention missed sessions or compare her with others.
Profile setting hide_achievements hides this whole feature.

definitions.sessions_completed: Strength, cardio and single sessions she finished (at least one set or block ticked). Stretch sessions are counted separately.
definitions.gold_weeks: Weeks where she completed every session she planned (AGENTS.md H1).
definitions.weeks_trained: Lifetime count of weeks (Monday to Sunday) with at least one counted session. Never resets.
definitions.current_run_weeks: Current run of consecutive counted weeks; rest weeks and repaired weeks keep the run alive (H1).
definitions.personal_bests: Times she beat her previous best estimated strength on an exercise (heaviest weight for at least the same reps). Ramp-up and warm-up sets never count.
definitions.checkpoints_completed: Checkpoint weeks finished with at least one checkpoint lift logged.
definitions.total_volume_kg: Sum of weight x reps across all working sets. Excludes ramp-up and warm-up sets and bodyweight exercises.
definitions.distinct_equipment_types_logged: Equipment types (from the strength catalogue) of exercises she has logged at least one working set of.
definitions.distinct_exercises_logged: Different exercise slugs she has logged at least one working set of.
definitions.baseline_note: Machines she ticked as 'used before' in onboarding count towards Gym unlocked progress but don't award first-time badges for them.
